title: Mathematical foundation of symmetric fast Fourier transform
summary: In this work, we study the fast Fourier transform (FFT) of discrete data with crystallographic symmetry, for which standard FFT algorithms incur substantial redundant computation. We establish a rigorous mathematical theory of the symmetric fast Fourier transform (SFFT) for $n$-dimensional crystallographic groups and propose the SFFT and symmetric inverse fast Fourier transform (SIFFT) algorithms.
